united_earth_is_1: Akwai mutane da yawa da suke son ceton duniyarmu. Associationsungiyoyi marasa yawa, ƙungiyoyi, kamfanoni da mutane marasa aure. Amma ba mu san juna ba.
united_earth_is_2: Me zai hana mu nuna adadinmu?
united_earth_is_3: Dole ne mu haɗu da juna don nuna irin ƙarfin da motsinmu yake da shi. Idan mun san adadinmu, za mu iya taimaka wa mutane su sauya yadda suke ji game da canjin yanayi zuwa ƙarfin zuciya da amincewa. Zamu iya baiwa mutane ikon fara matakan kariya daga yanayi. Tare kawai zamu iya canza duniya da ceton sauyin yanayi!
united_earth_is_4: Canza duniya ta hanyar yin rijista a gidan yanar gizon mu! Mu ne mafi rinjaye!
united_earth_is_5: Muna matukar gayyatarku don raba wannan bayanin ga abokai, abokan aiki da abokan arziki.

about_us_2: Idan muka nuna yawancinmu, za mu iya taimaka wa mutane su canza yadda suke ji game da canjin yanayi daga yanke tsammani zuwa ƙarfin zuciya da amincewa. Zamu iya baiwa mutane ikon fara matakan kariya daga yanayi.
about_us_3: Amma sama da duka: Ba za mu sake jin kaɗaici da rashin ƙarfi ba. Zai kawo mu tare. Zai ba mu bege, ƙarfi, ƙarfin zuciya da amincewa. Za mu ji daɗi a duk faɗin duniya - ceton duniyarmu da kuma aiki don kyakkyawar makoma.
about_us_4: Manufarmu ita ce ba mutane kwarin gwiwa, kwarin gwiwa da iko su fara nasu matakan kare yanayi.
about_us_5: Hankali: Babu fada saboda banbancin ra'ayoyi - yakini, ba tilastawa yakamata ya zama tushen mu kare duniyarmu ba.
about_us_6: Mutane 100, duk suna magana da yarurruka daban-daban, suna jere tare a cikin jirgin ruwa zuwa ruwan. Kusan duk wanda ke cikin jirgin ruwan ya san halin haɗari. Amma kusan kowa yana tunanin shine kadai wanda ya san hakan. "Me zan iya yi?", Kowa yana tunani. "Yin layi a daya bangaren bashi da amfani!" Kuma kowa yana shagaltar da halaye irin na da. Menene zai faru idan ba zato ba tsammani kowa ya san juna - ya san cewa kowa yana son juyawa kuma suna iya sadarwa da juna?
about_us_7: Wouldungiyar zata tsaya ta juya jirgin ruwan.
about_us_8: -Asar-Duniya 2022 - jectaddara don halartar ecolabel ta Austrian.
about_us_9: Shafin yanar gizo da kuma shafukan yanar gizo masu alaƙa sun yi ɗalibai da malamai 200 a wata makarantar Austriya.
about_us_10: An gudanar da aikin ne azaman ƙaramin tsari don halartar ecolabel ta Austrian. Duk abubuwan yanar gizon an ƙirƙira su azaman aikin makaranta.
about_us_11: Mayila mu iya bin addinai daban-daban, sun bambanta da shekaru da kuma asalinsu, amma duk muna son ceton duniyarmu. Duk mahalarta masu aikin agaji ne.
